t: The Lamp Post block extends upward when placed on top of itself and a has directional facing for decorating purposes. $(br)The top of a Lamp Post will light up if you use a Torch on it. $(br2)Remove the torch and "turn off" the Lamp Post by clicking on it with an empty hand.
灯柱方块叠放时可向上延伸，且具备方向朝向以便装饰。$(br)若在其顶部放置火把，灯柱顶端将发光。$(br2)移除火把并空手点击灯柱，即可“关闭”灯柱。

When a Lamp Post Block is 3 blocks tall, the thin pole section can be decorated by using either a bow or any type of wreath on it. $(br2)Remove the decoration by clicking on the pole with an empty hand.
当灯柱方块堆叠至3格高时，细长灯杆部分可通过在其上放置弓或任一类型花环进行装饰。$(br2)空手点击灯杆即可移除装饰。
